protocol_tests.static_validator_runner: Existing pytest-style tmp_path-only functions invoked unchanged with temporary Path fixtures via unittest; pytest is not installed and no shared environment was modified.

limits: Protocol acceptance uses real Chrome and a managed Python Worker with an explicit test fixture; it is not a Harness/model score or H021 business-rule acceptance.
DOM visibility and native geometry hits are observations. Composition, overpaint, filters, masks and semantic correctness require task-level cross-checking with actual pixels and source evidence.

Canvas fill/drawImage/putImageData, WebGL/offscreen transfer, rotated/3D CSS and iframe content do not have a complete generic vector reconstruction guarantee. Legal unhandled charts must remain evaluation_error/null.
The lock binds browser/Node executables, core assets, observer, platform and settings, not all OS dynamic libraries or fallback fonts.

Archive verification checks source, resource, script, request, observation and derived-byte context without rendering. It cannot cryptographically attest that an arbitrarily rewritten self-consistent receipt was produced by a real browser.
Windows browser/process lifecycle, H021 candidate matrix and formal MD Worker, all60 release freeze and12-task four-Harness calibration remain pending.
